...

Flapping Airplanes was founded in late 2025 and has no product on sale. Its valuation quadrupled from the $1.5 billion set by a $180 million seed round in January.

...

Arda was founded by Bob McGrew, OpenAI’s former chief research officer. A prior $72 million seed round brings its total to $232 million, and its software is in use at Anduril.

...

Watchtower Labs came out of stealth with its seed round. The Defense Innovation Unit selected it in January for a program on military sustainment decisions.

Mave’s new Series A brings its total to $34 million, including a $6 million seed. It says its agents run in more than 200 security operations centers.

AI funding hits $5.2B as Tenstorrent and Flapping Airplanes lead week (Oct 18-Oct 25, 2026) - AI Funding Tracker

# AI funding hits $5.2B as Tenstorrent and Flapping Airplanes lead week (Oct 18-Oct 25, 2026)

By Dan Lennox October 24, 2026 Updated: October 26, 2026 No Comments 12 Mins Read

AI startups announced about $5.18 billion in primary equity funding across 25 rounds of $20 million or more between October 19 and October 25, 2026. That is more than double last week’s $2.42 billion tally.

Tenstorrent’s $1.5 billion Series E was the largest round, at about 29% of the total. Flapping Airpl
